steps.narrate: Two figures share the shade at the edge of the Fields.

steps.line: You still hum when you weed. The same tune as years ago.
And you still pretend you don't know the words.
Show me the mushroom patch you keep bragging about.
Only if you promise not to tell {farmer}.
I tell {farmer} everything. That's half the fun.
Do you miss how it was, before the farm?
Some days. Then the carrots come up and I forget to.

then.line: {farmer} remembered how we take it. Of course.

steps.line: I'm glad we ended up in the same place again.

steps.narrate: Two lanterns at the water's edge, long after the work is done.

steps.line: When I wanted to quit, you were the one who wouldn't let me.
You'd have done the same. You did, later.
Whatever comes next, I'd like it to be near you.
Then it's settled. Same valley, same mornings.

steps.narrate: Below them, the farm wakes up one window at a time.
